title: A Second Tongue: Adept
summary: Adept work is the grammar under every other school's vocabulary, which is why nobody respects it and everybody uses it. Communion opens when the guild's permanent understanding of a school reaches fluency, whether or not you have ever played it.

objectives.text: Earn fluency in Adept, the generalist's tongue

title: A Second Tongue: Elementalist
summary: Elementalism is not a language for describing fire. It is a language fire is willing to be addressed in. Communion opens when the guild's permanent understanding of a school reaches fluency, whether or not you have ever played it.

objectives.text: Earn fluency in Elementalist, the unleashed tongue

title: A Second Tongue: Druid
summary: The Druid idiom has no word for a thing that is not alive, which makes it useless for half of magic and indispensable for the other half. Communion opens when the guild's permanent understanding of a school reaches fluency, whether or not you have ever played it.

objectives.text: Earn fluency in Druid, the green tongue

title: A Second Tongue: Necromancer
summary: Necromancy's working language is almost entirely in the past tense. Fluency means learning to hear the tense as a courtesy rather than a limitation. Communion opens when the guild's permanent understanding of a school reaches fluency, whether or not you have ever played it.

objectives.text: Earn fluency in Necromancer, the last tongue

title: A Second Tongue: Tinker
summary: Tinker shorthand is a contract notation that grew into a spell notation. It is the only school whose idiom is legally binding. Communion opens when the guild's permanent understanding of a school reaches fluency, whether or not you have ever played it.

objectives.text: Earn fluency in Tinker, the charter tongue

title: A Second Tongue: Enchanter
summary: Enchantment's idiom is built to be overheard and misunderstood in a specific direction. Fluency is knowing which direction. Communion opens when the guild's permanent understanding of a school reaches fluency, whether or not you have ever played it.

objectives.text: Earn fluency in Enchanter, the borrowed tongue

title: A Second Tongue: Arcanist
summary: The Arcanist working language was standardised before the Collapse and has not moved since, which is either rigour or rigor mortis. Communion opens when the guild's permanent understanding of a school reaches fluency, whether or not you have ever played it.

objectives.text: Earn fluency in Arcanist, the recorded tongue

title: A Second Tongue: Chronomancer
summary: Chronomantic notation marks tense on the verb and certainty on the noun, and its speakers find every other school's grammar unbearably vague. Communion opens when the guild's permanent understanding of a school reaches fluency, whether or not you have ever played it.

objectives.text: Earn fluency in Chronomancer, the stopped tongue
